summary: Historical assessment from 6 September 2026, before the fixes in REVIEW_CHANGES.md: reward-control fields were client-writable and authenticated users could modify any chat message. Deployed rules were not inspected.

findings.issue: User updates use a denylist that omits last_bonus_sponsor_claim, last_ecosystem_video_claim, last_direct_faucet_claim and active_trick_buffs, which backend reward logic consumes.
findings.recommendation: Allow only explicitly approved profile fields on update; validate their types and lengths. Add emulator tests proving reward fields cannot be created, changed or deleted by clients.

findings.issue: Any authenticated user can create, update or delete any chat_messages document, bypassing backend moderation, ownership checks and rate limits.
findings.recommendation: Make chat writes server-only and route all chat mutations through validated backend operations.

findings.issue: Allowed profile fields have no type or length validation, and direct chat writes have no field or size validation.
findings.recommendation: Validate profile field types and lengths and constrain all server-side chat inputs.
